values.note: Tent-only group sites $30 (up to 20 people, 4 vehicles).

fees.source: NPS campground record for Belle Fourche River Campground (developer.nps.gov, the data behind https://www.nps.gov/deto/planyourvisit/campgrounds.htm): fees 'Individual Sites' 20.00, 'Accessible Sites' 20.00, 'Group Sites' 30.00; read 2026-11-20

values.note: Fills on some nights June-September; sites are typically available until about 6 pm. Occupancy may not exceed 14 cumulative days in any 28.

booking.source: NPS campground record (reservationInfo: 'No reservations are available for this campground. Occupation is on a first come, first served basis. There is a 14 day limit on occupancy. The campground will fill on some nights from June through September. There are typically sites available until 6:00 pm every day.'; regulations: '14 cumulative days within a 28-day period'), read 2026-11-20

season.source: NPS campground record (operatingHours: 'The Belle Fourche Campground will be open for the season May 15 - Mid October.'; Off-Season Closure 2026-10-15 to 2027-05-15), read 2026-11-20

values.note: Two loops: 43 pull-throughs for RVs up to 35 ft, 4 accessible sites (A2, A4, B11, B25) and 3 tent-only group sites. Long vehicles and trailers are steered to B Loop.

sites.source: NPS campground record (description: 'a 2-loop, 45-site campground (43 pull-through sites with room for RVs up to 35'') with 4 ADA sites and 3 tent-only group sites'; rvInfo: 'Long vehicles and vehicles with trailers are recommended to use B Loop'; rvMaxLength 35), read 2026-11-20

hookups.source: NPS campground record ('No hookups are available'; electricalHookups 0), read 2026-11-20

values.note: Flush toilets and drinking water are seasonal. Picnic shelter and amphitheater by the campground.

facilities.source: NPS campground record (amenities: toilets 'Flush Toilets - seasonal', showers 'None', potableWater 'Yes - seasonal', dumpStation 'No', laundry 'No', campStore 'No'), read 2026-11-20

note: NPS campground in a bend of the Belle Fourche River below Devils Tower, shaded by large cottonwoods; paved roads, gravel pads. Generators 8 am - 8 pm. --Claude
summary: NPS page/record: confirmed 45 sites (43 pull-through to 35 ft), no hookups, FCFS only, 14-day limit, $20; added season May 15-Oct 14 (2026-27 closure dates), flush toilets/no showers/no dump. riverview confirmed (loops ~45-60 m from a ~10 m channel across grass with scattered cottonwoods; no per-site numbers, so no upgrade). Pin ~85 m from the loops' centre.
flags: Missing phone: empty -> 307-467-5283 ext. 741 (NPS campground record; the park's main line).

Waterfront riverview kept: the Belle Fourche River meanders around the campground on three sides, but its channel is only ~10 m wide here (creekside-sized), and the loop edges sit ~45-60 m from it across open grass with scattered cottonwoods.
